component.name: Luma
component.summary: A fast, native file manager for Linux

description.p: Luma pairs a calm, Finder-like interface with the depth of a power-user file manager. It is built on GTK 4 and libadwaita and works with Wayland and X11.

ul.li: Icon, list, column and gallery views with background thumbnails
Tabs, split view, bookmarks, tags and Quick Look previews
Reliable background copy, move and delete with conflict handling and undo
Archives, search, duplicate finder, file compare, batch rename and permissions
Git status, Google Drive, network locations and removable drives
